issue: Argument injection: WgturnUrl/VkLink interpolated into ProcessStartInfo.Arguments string; a double-quote in either value breaks argument boundaries and lets a malicious wgturn:// URL inject a second -url flag that overrides the tunnel endpoint
fix: Replace the Arguments string with ArgumentList (the pattern ProcessRunner uses everywhere else): psi.ArgumentList.Add("connect-url"); psi.ArgumentList.Add("-url"); psi.ArgumentList.Add(config.WgturnUrl); etc. Add a test that a WgturnUrl containing a double-quote is passed verbatim as a single argv element.

issue: Full subscription URL (which commonly carries an auth token in the query string) is logged verbatim via logger.Information("[Subscription] Fetching {Url}", url); the raw vpnrouter*.log lands in %ProgramData%\VPNRouter\logs which inherits Users:Read on Windows, leaking the provider credential to every local user
fix: Log only scheme+host (mirror DiagnosticsRedactor.RedactUrlKeepHost): var safe = Uri.TryCreate(url,…) ? $"{u.Scheme}://{u.Host}/[redacted]" : "[redacted]"; logger.Information("[Subscription] Fetching {Url}", safe). Apply the same redaction to the HTTP-status warning at line 69 and the fetched-count info at line 88.

issue: config.yaml and config/current.json (VLESS uuid, subscription URLs, Reality short_id) are written under %ProgramData%\VPNRouter with inherited Users:Read ACL; neither EnsureDirectories() nor packaging/windows/install.ps1 sets restrictive ACLs, so any local low-privilege user can read another user's VPN credentials
fix: In install.ps1 after creating $DataRoot, run icacls $DataRoot /inheritance:r /grant:r 'SYSTEM:(OI)(CI)F' 'Administrators:(OI)(CI)F' "$env:USERNAME:(OI)(CI)M" to strip Users:Read; mirror in AppPaths.EnsureDirectories via a Windows-only DirectorySecurity set for the service-account SID.

issue: Zapret ZIP downloaded from a GitHub release is extracted and winws.exe executed with only a Content-Length size check; no SHA256 pin, unlike TgProxyUpdater.VerifyPinnedSha256 which pins the Python embeddable and every PyPI wheel
fix: Pin the release ZIP sha256 (or at minimum the winws.exe hash inside it) as a const and call TgProxyUpdater.VerifyPinnedSha256Static before ExtractToDirectory; bump the pin on each upstream release.
